Unfortunately, after subscribing, I found that there was only one 8D sound available. There really isn’t much variety to choose from, and I also feel like the Focus, Sleep, and Relaxation options all sound very similar.
What made the experience even more disappointing is that, despite purchasing a yearly subscription, every time I open the app I’m bombarded with promotions asking me to purchase a lifetime subscription. It’s frustrating to pay for a full year and still constantly feel like I’m being advertised to and pushed to spend more money.
Overall, the app just wasn’t what I expected based on the advertising. I was hoping for a much wider selection of immersive sounds and more variety between the different modes. For the price, I expected a lot more.

title.label: Unethical strategies to make it nearly impossible to cancel

content.label:
I signed up for a seven day trial, and when I signed up, I immediately went to cancel so I wouldn’t forget to do so before the trial period was up if I didn’t want to continue it. When I went to cancel it immediately, there was even place to mark why I was canceling now, and one of their options was “so I wouldn’t forget”. Despite immediately having cancelled, I today that I would be charged tomorrow. So I went onto the app to cancel. Going to the “contact support“ section tells you to go to settings and hit manage subscriptions and there you will see “cancel subscriptions“ - but that is not written there. The layout of that page is misleadingly organized, with “unsubscribe“ at the bottom, situated to make you think you’re unsubscribing from communications, not canceling your subscription. Long story short, went through multiple avenues following their false steps to cancel, sent down different rabbit holes; sending the email on the “contact support page“ did not work, and eventually I just went back to that settings page and went to the bottom to hit unsubscribe. Well THAT is actually where you cancel your subscription! But then they interrupt that process by asking you to take a survey. If you x out of the survey, it ends your cancellation process. You have to start over again, you have to open the browser window for the survey, then you have to click several more times in the app to confirm you want to cancel. 
One of the most unethical and convoluted strategies of ever come across to make it difficult for consumers to cancel. Should be illegal. If we can all sign up to pay with one click, we should be able to cancel with one click.
